checks: Native experiment_protocol.py check-export --protocol exactfrozenprotocol --verify-files after export; record all findings, no synthetic values toforcepass.
failure_policy: Keep actual attemptedprocess rows/partials. Missing child is not fabricated; export coverage/schema findings remain explicit. compute_flow applies actual rows, planned2 retained protocol/observation note.

field_map.analysis.outputs: Actual reference-verification/candidate-audit/verification-summary files with digest/size; retained_recovery_classification is SHARED audit analysis, not duplicated independent child counts
field_map.finished_at: actual process.finished_at if present, otherwise null
field_map.measurements.counted.aa_integrity: Actual AA/control classification from independent checker, shared gate labelled dependent
field_map.measurements.counted.canonical_public_ce: Actual sum(len(group.scalars)) in that child certificate, never planned1536 copied as an observation
field_map.status: Actual returncode0/wait+certificate/independentcheck =>succeeded; actual nonzero=>failed; recorded termination/timeout asactual; absent child=>omit row and retain explicit coverage finding
field_map.verification: Actual independentchecker status for that exact child certificate, not producer booleans
field_map.worker: actual process PID and source argv

generic_formatter: Existing pinned tools/experiment_protocol.py from-rows/direct schema with this fixed mapping; no scientific rerun or adaptive analysis.
host: Actual worker/environment facts; unknownfields null, no inferred isolation; no validclock.
process_binding: Require exactly matching actual worker-processes.json process label, PID, argv, wait_returned, returncode, started_at,finished_at; bind named certificate payload size/digest from actual seal. Never fabricate absent child/PID/exit/clock or run directory.
row_identity_policy: Logical export aliases for actual child processes ONLY, no native child RUN dirs/manifests, no extra trials or population samples.
stored_representation_policy: After native checker, use execution-receipt.json artifact_storage plus unchanged tools/artifact_store.py read_json/open_artifact for logical payloads; verify logical content SHA before extracting metadata. Export.files and analysis.outputs pin ACTUAL existing stored representation path/bytes/SHA (raw/.gz/.blob.json or native manifest metadata), and retain native receipt binding of logical content and wire digest. Never recreate/overwrite sealed raw members, private-publish or invent scalar/process facts. If required stored bytes cannot be read/verified, retain precise export/check finding, not synthetic values.
